title: Breathable Sneakers – Lightweight Hiking Shoes
descriptionHtml:
Comfortable shoes for long days on your feet

Heavy and hot shoes make your feet tired and sweaty. On the hike and in everyday life you want shoes that both breathe and give support.

Light with a cushioning sole

These sneakers are made of breathable material and have a cushioning EVA sole. They are light on the foot and comfortable to wear all day.

Features

  • Breathable material
  • Cushioning EVA sole
  • Light on the foot
  • Good for hiking, running and everyday wear
  • Comfortable all year round

14 days to change your mind. Counted from the day you receive the item.
